title: In-App Update Apply Reliability and Progress Visibility
summary: Hardens Jellyfin FFmpeg build networking and adds granular in-app update progress, heartbeat, stale detection and operator guidance.
changelog: Bounds Jellyfin FFmpeg repository/key download and apt install with IPv4, timeout and retry controls.
Adds granular update apply progress, heartbeat and stale/stalled visibility in Settings maintenance.
Classifies Docker build and Jellyfin repository failures with sanitized operator actions.
